designSummary: Random-effects meta-analysis of severity-adjusted estimates for highest against lowest continuity, with structured synthesis where estimates are not comparable.
sampleSize: No sample size applies to a review. Pooling needs at least three severity-adjusted estimates using comparable contrasts; the preliminary search found one, so pooling may not be possible and the plan allows a synthesis without meta-analysis.
primaryAnalysis: Pooled log rate ratio with 95 percent confidence interval and prediction interval, if at least three comparable adjusted estimates exist.
secondaryAnalysis: Ambulatory care-sensitive admissions; intervention studies tabulated separately with waits.
missingData: Authors contacted once for adjusted estimates; unadjusted estimates are described, not pooled.
overfittingGuards: No meta-regression with fewer than ten studies
summary: Pooling only of comparable adjusted estimates; otherwise structured synthesis.
